crossRefs.note: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male…
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

translations.web: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
translations.bsb: and he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.
translations.kjv: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
translations.asv: And the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
